text: Frame-rate gap: net trained on 10 fps video steps, runs at 90 Hz
description: Training rollouts step at 10 fps (prepared footage); the runtime applies the net every 90 Hz frame, so its residual changes act ~9x as often per second. Options: `rate` fader (exists, scales the update), prepare footage at 30 fps, or train with sub-steps (net applied k times between video frames, loss only at frames).

status.comment: Resolved by the time model: training at native 24 fps with strides 0.25..2 and tau as net input; the app runs the net at netfps with tau = elapsed * rate (NetClock), certainty decay per tick. stereo24/deep24 trained this way.
